executionModel.portableSkillExecution: A skill can be run by an agent from its own cwd as instructions plus readable and writable files, manifests, metadata, and generated artifacts.
executionModel.clashManagedExecution: Clash can optionally host the same workflow as managed actions that register assets, fill metadata, preserve provenance, gate review, and apply canvas/timeline projections with CAS.
executionModel.hardBoundary: The skill owns the workflow and artifact contract; Clash owns collaboration and project-state management. A missing Clash system capability must not prevent portable skill execution.

marketplaceSemantics.hostCapabilityContract: Skills depend on named host capability contracts, not Clash private storage or UI internals. Clash is one host implementation that provides collaboration, permissioning, asset registry, metadata fill, provenance, review gates, and CAS apply.

artifactContract.skillOwnedWorkspace: The agent owns its cwd as a draft workspace and may read/write declared project files, actions, assets, metadata, manifests, schemas, and projections there before explicit apply.
artifactContract.forbiddenDependencyPolicy: Portable skills must not depend on snapshot.bin, SQLite rows, Loro documents, canvas private node state, runtime secrets, or any other Clash-private storage surface; managed Clash execution must expose those changes through public action, metadata, asset, and CAS projection contracts.

marketplaceSemantics.systemCapabilityMeaning: requiredSystemCapabilities is a compatibility field for Clash-native automation bindings needed for fully managed execution. These capabilities are not required to run a skill as a portable file/artifact workflow outside Clash.

statusPolicy.ready: ready means the skill has a runnable local CLI/action contract with contract tests proving its declared production artifacts, metadata, assets, or view projections.
statusPolicy.blockedBySystemGap: blocked-by-system-gap skills must list systemGaps with a capability, concrete missing behavior, and unblockSignal for Clash-managed execution.

systemGaps.gap: Project assets and multi-Canvas state exist, but the public CLI cannot yet create a same-revision asset placement on another Canvas for cross-Canvas reference-driven generation.

systemCapabilities.title: Asset registry
systemCapabilities.description: Project-local assets/manifest.json can record production metadata and storyboard panel assets, while completed Timeline renders create product Asset nodes. Stable SQLite rows and full path ownership checks still need durable integration across every media workflow.

systemCapabilities.title: Analysis metadata store
systemCapabilities.description: Native Documents provide Host-backed create/read/pull/apply/copy and revision-pinned attachments. Historical metadata manifests/indexes remain read-only compatibility; automatic legacy consumer migration is not delivered.

systemCapabilities.title: Copy-on-write media edits
systemCapabilities.description: Derived assets record parents, operation, and hashes; referenced media is never overwritten. The dedicated overlay projection command is retired; see SYSTEM_CAPABILITIES.md.

systemCapabilities.title: Rights and source ledger
systemCapabilities.description: Reference rights metadata schema, remix guard, and agent-readable rights-ledger projection exist; durable project storage, attribution export, and legal review workflow still missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Timeline CAS projection
systemCapabilities.description: Agent-readable timeline files with stale-write protection and host-enforced compare-and-swap apply.

systemCapabilities.title: Export validation
systemCapabilities.description: Timeline render receipts and final media assets provide codec, duration, dimensions, and playable-output evidence; TVC delivery validation can consume ffprobe media probes. Loudness, OCR/logo, and broad referenced-media validation remain incomplete.

systemCapabilities.title: ASR word timestamps
systemCapabilities.description: plan-text-cut records existing ASR transcript provenance with source path/hash, backend/model, language, wordCount, optional confidence/speaker metadata, and apply-metadata writes a readable asr-transcript projection; executing ASR backends and transcript review UI remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Filler and tone-particle analysis
systemCapabilities.description: Deterministic planner detects configured filler words, tone particles, and adjacent repeated words from existing word timestamps; semantic discourse-marker confidence and broader false-start analysis still need an analysis backend.

systemCapabilities.title: Text-based cut plan
systemCapabilities.description: Talking-head transcript/cut metadata schema, plan-text-cut CLI action generation with ASR transcript provenance path/hash/backend/model, caption projection, filler/silence auto-delete suggestions, tone-particle/repeat review suggestions, export-captions SRT/VTT/ASS sidecars, project-caption-overlay CAS subtitle timeline projection, export-caption-burn copy-on-write package plus optional FFmpeg render, export-timeline-handoff CSV review handoff, and export-text-cut-media non-destructive FFmpeg cut package with reviewRanges plus ffprobe-validated rendered video assets only after pending review cuts are cleared; ASR execution, review UI, crossfades, batch operations, and OTIO/EDL handoff remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Public reference ingest
systemCapabilities.description: Reference review and non-copying QA actions record source URL, rights, shots, structured QA report, rights-ledger projection, and analysis-only shot-analysis projection without redistribution; plan-reference-download creates a blocked-by-default yt-dlp command plan with raw-reference quarantine, and execute-reference-download can explicitly run an allowed plan locally, reject tampered executables and yt-dlp local-execution flags, write a download receipt, and register reference.download metadata on a quarantined raw reference asset. Browser capture, cookie/session handling, and platform terms review remain missing.

systemCapabilities.title: Remotion composition renderer
systemCapabilities.description: Canvas remotion-component nodes hold editable default-exported Remotion TSX. Timeline composition items bind the fixed Canvas identity through sourceNodeId, preview and render resolve the latest TSX, and Timeline render produces the final product Asset and completion receipt.

systemCapabilities.title: Silence analysis
systemCapabilities.description: Word-gap silence detection exists in plan-text-cut; waveform VAD/RMS thresholds, margins, smoothing, and review recommendations still need an audio backend.

systemCapabilities.title: Open-source license ledger
systemCapabilities.description: Tracks third-party reference licenses, integration policy, NOTICE obligations, and review-required sources before code/model/tool reuse.
